title: Walkie Chat continuity and convergence
human_intent: Preserve and continue the Walkie web-chat product without depending on the exhausted historical chat, recover exact served/candidate state from durable external evidence, and converge the configurable-voice candidate into the stable product only after regression-safe comparison.

truth_order: Exact Vercel served/deployment bytes for SERVED claims
Historical chat only for human intent, accepted direction and negative knowledge
authority.rule: A project/deployment/version name never promotes a candidate to SERVED or Human Accepted.

already_decided: Keep the Walkie landing visually retro/bicolor with a dominant left-anchored hero and a physical theme knob.
Keep the WALKIE / CHAT wordmark visually attached to the antenna; the unresolved requested adjustment is to make it larger, not redesign it from scratch.
Private-link flow should remain low-friction: link plus COPIAR and ENTRAR, without redundant controls.
Room entry and first paint must not depend on jsDelivr/realtime or another external origin in a way that can strand the user on a loader.
Public/private rooms, audio, saved items, themes and the existing knob are preservation targets unless exact served verification disproves a historical claim.
Configurable voice is a separate candidate until exact comparison proves what it contains and a regression-safe convergence is performed.
known_failures: Hybrid navigation that resolved rooms against jsDelivr/external resources instead of the stable public origin.
Loader/first-paint architecture that can block the usable UI on network/realtime dependencies.
Declaring a fix complete from chat text when the served bytes still implement a different mechanism.
Treating the separate custom-voice Vercel project as automatically integrated into walkie-chat.
Redesigning accepted landing/room behavior while attempting to recover voice functionality.
verified_2026_09_09: The public stable project walkie-chat exists in Vercel and serves https://walkie-chat.vercel.app/.

The current public boot page is self-contained enough to render a loader, but it still loads pako from cdnjs and replaces the document via document.open/document.write/document.close after inflating its payload; therefore the old-chat statement that document.write had been eliminated is not accepted as current SERVED truth.

A separate Vercel project walkie-v18-custom-voice exists and has a READY deployment, but its exact page bytes are currently protected by Vercel Authentication; its internal capability set remains UNVERIFIED_CANDIDATE rather than inferred from the name.
write_scope: walkie/** only after an exact canonical source is materialized there
coordination/DELTA_FEED.json only for genuinely cross-workstream information
read_only_by_default: Vercel production project configuration and environment secrets
high_value_targets: Establish a canonical durable source snapshot for the exact stable served Walkie app without exposing Vercel environment payloads or private room data.
Obtain/compare the exact configurable-voice candidate source/served bytes against the stable source.
Converge only the proven voice/internal improvements and requested larger wordmark while preserving stable routing, rooms, audio, saved items, themes and landing behavior.
Add regression checks for same-origin room navigation, non-blocking first paint, stable public/private room entry and voice controls.
Deploy a candidate, verify exact served bytes, then request human acceptance only if a product-facing promotion is required.
privacy: Never commit WALKIE_PAYLOAD or any Vercel environment value.
Never commit private room contents, messages, recordings, transcripts, invite secrets or user identifiers.
Public recovery artifacts contain only sanitized product/technical knowledge.
